name: Mira

faq.question: The dashboard asks for a login I never set
faq.answer: Without an admin password file, Mira generates a random password on the first start and writes it to user-data/indexes/initial_admin_password inside this app's folder. Set the Dashboard admin password file setting to choose your own.

faq.question: Reviews fail with an LLM or API key error
faq.answer: Set the LLM API key file to a text file holding your provider key, and check the LLM base URL and model. OpenRouter needs its /api/v1 path. Local endpoints may need the model name their server reports.

faq.question: GitHub pull requests are not reviewed
faq.answer: Fill the GitHub App ID, private key file and webhook secret file, then expose /github/webhook to GitHub. Without those settings Mira still runs the dashboard and local reviews.

faq.question: PostgreSQL did not start on the configured port
faq.answer: pg0 picks a free port when the configured one is taken and Mira receives the actual connection string. Check the app output for the chosen port.

description: Self-hosted AI code review with repository indexing, a dashboard and your own LLM key.

settings.label: Port
settings.help: Local port for the Mira dashboard and API.

settings.label: PostgreSQL port
settings.help: Port for this app's pg0 PostgreSQL instance. pg0 picks a free port when it is taken.

settings.label: pg0 binaries folder
settings.help: PostgreSQL binaries for the embedded database. Sharing Autark's copy is opt-in through the migration buttons on this page. The databases always stay in this app.

settings.label: LLM base URL
settings.help: OpenAI-compatible endpoint, such as OpenRouter, vLLM or Ollama. Plain http is accepted only for local hosts.

settings.label: LLM model
settings.help: Model ID for review, indexing and security passes. The dashboard can override it later.

settings.label: LLM API key file
settings.help: Path to a text file holding the API key. Autark settings are not secret storage. Blank runs the dashboard without an LLM.

settings.label: Dashboard admin password file
settings.help: Optional. Blank lets Mira generate a random password on the first start and write it under user-data/indexes.

settings.label: GitHub App ID
settings.help: Optional. Enables the GitHub webhook route; the private key and webhook secret come from the files below.

settings.label: GitHub App private key file
settings.help: PEM file downloaded from the GitHub App settings.

settings.label: GitHub webhook secret file
settings.help: Text file holding the webhook secret configured on the GitHub App.

steps.name: Install Mira with the server extras and the pg0 SDK
